content: Supabase CLI 2.117.0. Type generation: 'npx supabase gen types typescript --project-id $REF --schema public > types.ts' or --local / --db-url for self-hosted; --linked is not documented. Drift detection pattern is regenerate then 'git diff --exit-code' in CI. Schema drift: 'supabase db diff --schema public' shows SQL delta, 'supabase db pull [--schema x]' imports remote schema into migrations, 'supabase db reset' replays migrations locally, 'supabase link --project-ref'. Testing: 'supabase test new <name>.test' then 'supabase test db'.
